fewShots.question: Which critical path activities have the largest hours overrun?
fewShots.query:
SELECT TOP 10 p.project_name, a.activity_code, a.activity_name, d.discipline_name,
       a.planned_hours, a.actual_hours, a.actual_hours - a.planned_hours AS overrun_hours, a.percent_complete
FROM dbo.dim_activity a
JOIN dbo.dim_project p ON a.project_key = p.project_key
JOIN dbo.dim_discipline d ON a.discipline_key = d.discipline_key
WHERE a.is_critical_path = 1 AND a.actual_hours > a.planned_hours
ORDER BY overrun_hours DESC;

fewShots.question: Which activities are due to finish in the next 30 days but are less than half complete?
fewShots.query:
SELECT p.project_name, a.activity_code, a.activity_name, a.planned_finish_date, a.percent_complete
FROM dbo.dim_activity a
JOIN dbo.dim_project p ON a.project_key = p.project_key
WHERE a.activity_status <> 'Completed' AND a.percent_complete < 50
  AND a.planned_finish_date BETWEEN '2026-10-08' AND DATEADD(day, 30, '2026-10-08')
ORDER BY a.planned_finish_date;
